panels.title: temperature
panels.description: Null means a missing/failed reading. Light is raw, not lux.

targets.queryText: SELECT observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM environment_readings WHERE metric='temperature' AND observed_at_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY observed_at_ms
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time, value FROM environment_readings WHERE metric='temperature' AND observed_at_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY observed_at_ms

targets.queryText: SELECT observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time, scientific_name, confidence FROM detections WHERE observed_at_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY observed_at_ms DESC LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT observed_at_ms / 1000 AS time, scientific_name, confidence FROM detections WHERE observed_at_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to ORDER BY observed_at_ms DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Latest health and freshness
panels.description: Age > 120 seconds means stale; missing rows mean no health observations.

targets.queryText: SELECT station_id, max(observed_at_ms) / 1000 AS time, (strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - max(observed_at_ms)) / 1000 AS age_seconds, json_extract(payload,'$.services') AS services FROM health_events GROUP BY station_id
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT station_id, max(observed_at_ms) / 1000 AS time, (strftime('%s','now') * 1000 - max(observed_at_ms)) / 1000 AS age_seconds, json_extract(payload,'$.services') AS services FROM health_events GROUP BY station_id

panels.title: Daily archive with observed coverage
panels.description: Archive is materialized before retention purge. Use the daily API for current days. Coverage is any station event, not proven audio coverage.

targets.queryText: SELECT day, station_id, json_extract(payload,'$.detections_total') AS detections, json_extract(payload,'$.coverage.minutes_with_data') AS observed_minutes, json_extract(payload,'$.coverage.minutes_in_day') AS day_minutes FROM daily_summaries ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT day, station_id, json_extract(payload,'$.detections_total') AS detections, json_extract(payload,'$.coverage.minutes_with_data') AS observed_minutes, json_extract(payload,'$.coverage.minutes_in_day') AS day_minutes FROM daily_summaries ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 500
